cards.text: VEL-VIVIENNE-GS-EVERYTHING-01 — GREENSCREEN AI UGC

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: The live Vivienne 'everything bag' ad (instagram.com/p/DcaPXM8Asrn) held WORD FOR WORD and moved into the greenscreen AI UGC format. The script did not move; the voice did — fresh one-take render on ElevenLabs Woman Over 40, STT-gated, all 87 words present. She reads ~180wpm against the original's ~154, so the ad lands at 28.96s, 5.3s shorter than the live cut, and the whole bed re-times off her. The read ships as-is: NO atempo. Three creators, all women over 50, generated from a Pinterest crawl as look references only. One shared VO drives all three so the bed, captions and timings are identical and only the creator changes. The close is one unbroken 5.25s PDP screen recording that carries the entire offer and CTA — the ad ends on the website and never cuts back to the bag. Claim check 2026-08-31: every claim still holds ($199.99 to $149.99 = exactly 25%, four colorways live, 'Expected to ship October' on the page). GATE: nothing renders until Brooks picks the creator(s) and signs off GAP-01.
A

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Diane, 58
Silver-blonde hair to the shoulders with a soft wave, fair skin, sun lines at the eyes, freckling across the cheekbones, small gold hoops, cream chunky-knit crewneck.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Warm. The neighbour everybody trusts.

12.7% headroom, hands out of frame, mouth closed, eyes on lens. Cream knit is the one garment to watch on the despill — never push mix past 0.15 or it goes pink.
B

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Bridget, 53
Dark brown hair to the collarbone growing out naturally, grey coming through at the temples, tucked behind one ear. Fair freckled skin, rust fine-gauge knit, small gold hoops.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Warm, practical, no-nonsense.

14.8% headroom. The only non-silver head in the set — reads a decade younger than A and C, which is the point of having her in the test.
C

cards.text: Marguerite, 62
Sharp silver bob cut to the jaw, one side tucked behind the ear, pale olive skin, one thin gold chain, black fine-gauge turtleneck.

cards.title: EMOTION

Cool, precise. The friend with taste.

9.5% headroom. Black turtleneck is the safest garment for the key — no light-garment despill risk at all.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's twenty five percent off right now, and the first run ships in October. I left the link below.

ONE UNBROKEN 5.25s SCREEN RECORDING of the live PDP. Slow continuous downward scroll, no cuts inside it: price struck $199.99 to $149.99 with the four swatches, down through Add to Cart and the icon bar, settling and HOLDING on the pre-order paragraph and 'expected to ship October' for the final line.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Proof it is real, then go.

PiP bottom-LEFT, clear of the buy box. THE AD ENDS HERE — it never cuts back to the bag. O7 (walking out the front door), which closed the live ad, is dropped. Editor option if the hold feels soft: on 'I left the link below' ease the scroll back up to land on Add to Cart — still one continuous move, still no cut. Re-capture the day it ships, 500px CSS window width.

cards.title: THE BED — 14 cuts over 28.96s  ·  Vivienne organic b-roll library (O1-O12) + live PDP screen recording + real per-colorway renders. Creator keyed as a PiP at 32% frame width, bottom-anchored, side alternating per beat. Captions at y=1500.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: The script is locked; the voice is new
cards.text: Word for word from the live ad. Brooks directed ElevenLabs Woman Over 40, so the audio is a fresh one-take render (job_b9c9c407cad7), STT-gated, all 87 words present. She reads ~180wpm vs the original's ~154, so the cut is 28.96s instead of 34.25s.

cards.title: Ship the natural read
cards.text: No atempo, ever. Forcing a read to hit a target length is exactly what made the men's greenscreen cut sound robotic. The bed re-times to her instead.

cards.title: The close is the website, and it is unbroken
cards.text: c14 is a single 5.25s screen recording carrying the whole offer and CTA. The ad ends on the PDP. O7 is dropped.

cards.title: Two other shots moved
cards.text: O6 (bag on the cafe floor) is cut: she would not set a leather bag on a cafe floor. And 'brass feet' owned no frame, so GAP-01 was generated rather than the line softened.

cards.title: Claim check, 2026-08-31
cards.text: Every claim in the locked script still holds against the live PDP. $199.99 to $149.99 is exactly 25%. Four colorways live. 'Expected to ship October' is on the page.

cards.title: Creator-only A/B/C
cards.text: One shared VO across all three creators means the bed, the captions and every timing are identical. If it wins, we know it was the creator.

cards.title: Key values are per-creator
cards.text: HeyGen's green differs per source, so sweep it every time. Start at chromakey 0.10/0.02 with despill mix 0.15, and never 0.5 — it goes pink on Diane's cream knit.

cards.title: One person on screen
cards.text: No face appears in any b-roll cut. O9 is shot from behind. The keyed creator is the only person on screen for the full runtime.
